# Compute most common genre for each playlist and update titles
from collections import Counter

for pl in playlists:
    genres = all_playlist_genres[pl['playlist_id']]
    most_common = Counter(genres).most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl['playlist_id']} to: {new_title}")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(
        playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'],
        access_token=login_result['access_token'],
        title=new_title
    )
    print(result)
